taskpack.goal: Close P3-READY through deterministic provider-free evidence and operator review.
taskpack.integration_policy: No workers, model calls, provider calls, source merge, main mutation, or push; publish run-local evidence only.

contract.provider_policy: Provider launch and provider authorization are forbidden.
contract.evidence_policy: The fixed local fixture, full-suite output digests, readiness receipt, and operator approval are run-local authority.
contract.merge_policy: No automatic merge to main and no push.

decisions.subject: phase3_benchmark_readiness
decisions.statement: Prepare a decision-bound standard benchmark pilot without spending live provider budget.

alternatives.rejected_reason: It would spend claim-bearing budget before instance, fairness, and metric authority is frozen.

alternatives.option: start recovery or semantic experiments before the standard pilot
alternatives.rejected_reason: Those phases depend on evidence from the normal standard-benchmark path.

decisions.rationale: Phase 1 and Phase 2 established usage and harness capability; the next claim-bearing step requires a frozen standard-benchmark authority.
decisions.expected_outcome: A mechanically accepted readiness artifact suitable as input to a separately authorized live pilot.

decisions.subject: provider_free_readiness
decisions.statement: Verify Phase 3 adapter and preregistration end to end with fixtures and zero provider calls.

alternatives.option: use a live scored run as the first integration test
alternatives.rejected_reason: Deterministic contract and isolation defects should fail before provider cost is incurred.

decisions.rationale: Deterministic readiness must fail before expensive or claim-bearing execution begins.
decisions.expected_outcome: A passed receipt that can authorize preparation of a separate live-run taskpack.

success_criteria: The complete runtime test suite passes at the sealed integration head.
The fixed readiness fixture replays selection and preregistration and rejects mutations.
The readiness receipt reports zero live provider calls and no token totals.
P3-READY passes its registered relation validator before operator approval.
